title: Default Mirror Activation shortcut conflicts with non-US keyboard layouts

status.label: Corroborated hotkey regression
status.detail: German and Danish keyboard users reproduced ZoomIt's Mirror shortcut intercepting AltGr character input.

next_action.label: Design layout-safe hotkey behavior
next_action.reason: The current report includes exact keys, affected layouts, a current release, diagnostics, and independent confirmation.

actions.label: Design non-US hotkey fix
actions.note: Investigate ZoomIt hotkey registration and AltGr handling across non-US layouts, with regression tests for character entry. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The issue is reproducible on multiple keyboard layouts and clearly distinguishes expected character input from unintended ZoomIt activation.
evidence: On a German layout, AltGr+9 should type `]` but instead activates ZoomIt Mirror.
A Danish-layout user independently reproduced the same AltGr+9 conflict and another conflict after changing the Mirror shortcut.
The report targets PowerToys 0.101.2362 and includes a bug report attachment.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate ZoomIt shortcut registration and design layout-aware handling that does not treat AltGr character entry as the configured Ctrl+Alt shortcut.
